title: 82% of Contractors Face Payment Delays
hook: How big is that first gap, the unpaid A/R sitting in the ledger? Bad, and getting worse.
script: How big is that first gap, the unpaid A/R sitting in the ledger? Bad, and getting worse. A 2024 construction payments report found that eighty two percent of contractors reported payment delays of more than thirty days, up from just forty nine percent two years earlier. That's a sharp jump in a short window, and it's happening on the ledger side, the side no project-data AI can see, because the record of what actually got paid lives in the bank and in QuickBooks, not in a Procore invoice status.
